text:
marco_ae: Quick sync - NovaBank POC asks for an EU primary and a hot standby in us-west. They need: clear sub-processor list for standby, assurance no non-AWS/Azure third-parties touch data, and a pricing delta for warm vs hot standby. Who can help?

anya_se: Yep. Two immediate Qs: 1) On failover, will egress be via peered network or public internet? 2) Which sub-processors are active in us-west standby scenarios?

devon_sre: Default behavior: failover routes to the nearest compatible endpoint. If customer enables tenant peering, traffic stays on our peered path in us-west-2 (AWS). If not, it goes over public egress. For Dedicated customers we may use NetCrest for managed peering (third-party).

marco_ae: Customer stated "no third-party transfer outside AWS/Azure" for standby. They want timeline for attestations (SOC2/ISO) for any named sub-processors.

sarah_security: We can supply the roster + current attestation status. AWS/Azure nodes have SOC2. NetCrest is pending ISO27001; expected certification in ~6 weeks. If they require zero external vendors, recommend Dedicated with tenant peering so only cloud providers are in the stack.

anya_se: Sales needs a quick cost delta for SOW today. Simple model: warm standby (weights cached, minimal workers) vs hot standby (full capacity). Give low/med/high if possible.

devon_sre: Ballpark numbers (model agnostic): warm standby ~1.15x reserved cost; hot standby ~1.4x. Low/Med/High ranges depend on model size and RPS: low (1.1x/1.25x), med (1.15x/1.4x), high (1.2x/1.6x). Note: cross-region egress + peering charges are additional.

marco_ae: Can we propose a deterministic routing policy? Customer wants failover only to us-west, no fallback to other regions.

devon_sre: Suggested policy snippet: ```json
{"routing":"primary:eu-central-1,standby:us-west-2,failover_mode:manual,pinning_required:true,allow_fallback:false"}
```

sarah_security: If allow_fallback is false, update SLA appendix and include data-flow diagrams showing jurisdictional flows. I'll draft the security appendix and sub-processor table.

ops-bot: Note: dedicated-network-onboarding estimated 3 business days after legal sign-off + CIDR from customer.

anya_se: Action list: Sarah - send sub-processor roster + attestation ETA to Marco by EOD. Devon - refine pricing delta per model knob, provide low/med/high by 17:00. Marco - confirm whether customer accepts Dedicated+peering or requires Hosted-only path.

marco_ae: I'll check with procurement now and update. Thanks all :thumbsup:
